_comment: Single source of truth for the whole mod. Define each material's 1x1 stats once; the generators scale them to every size variant. Run `node tools/gen_rules.mjs` to (re)write all .rules + strings/en.rules + mod.rules, and `node tools/generate.mjs` to (re)render textures. perTile stats scale with tile count (resources, maxHealth, empAbsorb); intensive stats stay constant across sizes (resistances, density, penetration).

mod.name: Composite Armors
mod.author: Ritrodan
mod.description: Adds new armor types: NERA, Tri-Steel Armor, Combination C, Metal Foam, Gold Plating, and Depleted Uranium, with multiple size variants.

nera.description: A lightweight composite of steel plates and coils. NERA is very weight efficient and effectively reduces penetration depth, but it has less health than regular armor. NERA is moderately resiliant to blasts, but cannot fully absorb a blast and some damage will pass through it.

tri_steel.description: A very strong and weight efficient armor.

combination_c.description: High-hardness boron carbide spheres suspended in a steel matrix. Combination C resists penetration better than standard armor at the same HP, with mild thermal resistance.

metal_foam.description: Closed-pore hollow sphere steel foam. Negligible penetration resistance and catastrophically vulnerable to thermal damage, but provides exceptional blast absorption per unit cost.

gold_shielding.description: Hand-beaten gold plating offers extraordinary thermal insulation and acts as a superb Faraday cage, providing unmatched EMP protection. Its softness leaves it vulnerable to penetrating hits.

uranium.description: Extremely dense uranium plating packs enormous raw HP into a single block, but is heavy and has additional vulnerability to penetration and explosions.
